name: Postiz
description_en:
Postiz is a social publishing application available as a managed Cloud subscription or a self-hosted open-source stack. It combines a calendar, channel-specific content, media/AI creation, account analytics and automation through RSS, plugs, webhooks, API, CLI and MCP. The current documentation names 34 publishing platforms, but each connection has its own format, permissions and reporting coverage. Agent Media’s UGC video subscription is separate from Postiz plan allowances.

The key evaluation follows one post across channels and states: global text can be detached, an existing post edits differently, previews collect feedback without enforcing approval, and rejection needs correction/rescheduling. It suits a team or developer that wants several publishing routes while retaining a visible calendar. Cloud removes infrastructure/provider-app setup; self-hosting transfers that work and provider/AI costs to the operator. This research did not install the stack, connect channels, purchase a trial or verify published results.
description_zh:
Postiz 是社交发布应用，可用托管 Cloud 订阅或自托管开源技术栈，结合日历、逐渠道内容、媒体／AI 创作、账户分析及 RSS、plugs、webhooks、API、CLI、MCP 自动化。现行文档列 34 个发布平台，但各连接的格式、权限及报告覆盖不同。Agent Media 的 UGC 视频订阅独立于 Postiz 计划额度。

评估关键是跟踪一帖跨渠道及状态：全局文字可脱离、已有帖编辑行为不同、预览收反馈而不强制审批、拒绝后需修正重排。它适合需多条发布路径并保留可见日历的团队或开发者。Cloud 代管基础设施／开发者应用，自托管则由运营者承担这些工作及提供方／AI 成本。本研究未安装技术栈、连接渠道、购买试用或验证发布效果。

core_features.explanation_en: Detach one version without changing the remaining channels.
core_features.explanation_zh: 脱离一个版本而不改其余渠道。

core_features.name_zh: 不公开列出的反馈预览
core_features.explanation_en: Share comments without a Postiz account, without an enforced approval state.
core_features.explanation_zh: 无需 Postiz 账户即可评论，但没有强制审批状态。

core_features.explanation_en: RSS produces posts; scoped webhooks report publication.
core_features.explanation_zh: RSS 生成帖子，限定渠道 webhook 报告发布。

core_features.explanation_en: Hosting/provider setup differs even where application workflows align.
core_features.explanation_zh: 即使应用流程相同，托管／提供方设置仍不同。

en: Coordinate tailored multi-channel posts in a shared calendar.
Self-host publishing infrastructure with provider applications and operational ownership.
zh: 在共享日历协调逐渠道定制帖子。
自动化可控 RSS 到发布流程。
持提供方应用并承担运营责任自托管发布基础设施。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose Cloud or self-hosting and inventory exact channel/account requirements.
steps.zh: 选择 Cloud 或自托管并清点准确渠道／账户需求。

steps.en: Prepare a draft and inspect every detached channel version.
steps.zh: 准备草稿并检查每份脱离的渠道版本。

steps.en: Collect preview feedback and manually schedule only the reviewed version.
steps.zh: 收集预览反馈并手工排程已审版本。

steps.en: Check browser timezone, recurrence and existing-channel times before saving.
steps.zh: 保存前检查浏览器时区、循环及已有渠道时间。

steps.en: Inspect errors and supported metrics, then budget each independent usage pool.
steps.zh: 检查错误及支持指标，再预算各独立用量池。

items.en: Preview approval has no state that blocks publishing and URLs have no password.
items.zh: 预览审批没有阻止发布的状态，URL 无密码。

items.en: Recurring edits affect all future occurrences and Post Now acts on every channel.
items.zh: 循环修改影响全部未来次数，Post Now 作用全部渠道。

items.en: Rejected posts are not silently retried.
Self-hosting requires provider setup and operating responsibility.
items.zh: 自托管需提供方设置及运营责任。

license.scope_en: Postiz source repository; modified network version obligations apply. Hosted subscriptions and external-provider access remain separate.
license.scope_zh: Postiz 源码仓库，适用修改网络版本义务；托管订阅与外部提供方访问独立。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly cards: Standard $29/5 channels, Team $39/10, Pro $49/30, Ultimate $99/100; paid posts unlimited and API/CLI/MCP included. Cloud has no permanent free plan. Detailed docs give annual totals $278/$374/$470/$950; public FAQ shows rounded monthly equivalents $23/$31/$39/$79. Team+ includes unlimited members and RSS; the public Standard feature list also displays RSS/team-related labels, so use specific plan docs and confirm checkout. Refund FAQ: up to one month per account if last charge was within 120 days, annual plans excluded. Currency code/tax not established; no normalized price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月付卡片 Standard $29／5 渠道、Team $39／10、Pro $49／30、Ultimate $99／100，付费不限帖并含 API／CLI／MCP。Cloud 无永久免费档。详细文档年总额 $278／$374／$470／$950，公开 FAQ 显示取整月均 $23／$31／$39／$79。Team+ 含不限成员及 RSS，但公开 Standard 功能列也显示 RSS／团队相关标签，应结合具体计划文档并确认结算。退款 FAQ：最后扣费在 120 天内，每账户最多退一个月，排除年付。币种代码／税未确定，不分配标准化价格。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Detaching a channel changes future edits
sections.title_zh: 脱离渠道会改变后续编辑
sections.en: New-post Global content goes to selected channels. Edit content on one channel detaches it: global changes no longer reach that version, and its edits stay local. Returning to Global discards the customization after confirmation. Mentions work only on detached channels. Existing posts have no Global tab: each channel has its own content/date and the channel list is fixed; older-version posts may open only the clicked channel. The page suggests sets as a shortcut but explicitly says sets store channel selection/settings, not detached copy. Editorial launch check: inspect every detached version after changing the core announcement, and do not assume a saved set restores custom wording.
sections.zh: 新帖 Global 内容发往所选渠道。单渠道 Edit content 会脱离，全局修改不再同步，该渠道修改不影响其他；确认回 Global 会丢弃定制。提及仅在脱离渠道可用。已有帖没有 Global 页签，各渠道独立内容／日期且列表固定，旧版本帖可能仅打开所点渠道。页面建议 sets 作捷径，但明确 sets 存渠道选择／设置，不存脱离文字。编辑发布检查：改核心公告后逐份检查脱离版本，不能假设已存 set 恢复定制措辞。

sections.title_en: Update, Post Now and recurring edits affect different work
sections.title_zh: Update、Post Now 及循环修改影响不同范围
sections.en: Save as Draft never publishes; Add to calendar uses the selected date/time. Times follow the browser timezone, with no per-account timezone setting. Existing-post Update saves every channel but each retains its own time; an already-published channel stays published unless Republish is selected. A past-due sibling only saves details on Update/Schedule, requiring a new time; Post Now still publishes every channel. Recurring-post edits change all future occurrences. Editorial timed campaign: inspect each channel/date and the recurring warning before choosing the final action, rather than treating one visible date or update button as applying identical delivery behavior everywhere.
sections.zh: Save as Draft 不发布，Add to calendar 使用所选日期／时间。采用浏览器时区，没有逐账户时区。已有帖 Update 保存所有渠道但各自保留时间，已发渠道除非选 Republish 否则保持已发。过期的其他渠道在 Update／Schedule 仅保存详情，需新时间；Post Now 仍发布全部渠道。循环帖修改影响所有未来次数。编辑定时活动：最终动作前检查逐渠道／日期及循环警告，不能把一个可见日期或更新按钮理解为各处相同投递。

sections.title_en: Approval is feedback while the author controls scheduling
sections.title_zh: 审批是反馈，排程仍由作者控制
sections.en: A public preview renders the post/media/thread and scheduled date with a comment box. Recipients need no account and do not see the rest of the organization, but anyone holding the unpassworded URL can read/comment. The approval guide explicitly has no approved flag blocking publication. Its workflow is save drafts, share previews, apply comments, then schedule yourself. Editorial client handoff: keep work in Draft until sign-off and inspect the exact version afterward. The preview is unlisted rather than private, and collecting comments does not establish a role-enforced review gate or immutable approval record.
sections.zh: 公开预览显示帖子／媒体／线程、排程日期及评论框，收件人无需账户也看不到组织其余内容，但任何持无密码 URL 者均可读／评。审批指南明确没有阻止发布的 approved 标记。流程是保存草稿、分享预览、落实评论，再自己排程。编辑客户交接：签认前保留 Draft，之后检查准确版本。预览是不公开列出而非私密，收评论不确定角色强制审核门槛或不可变批准记录。

sections.title_en: Organization roles differ from client preview access
sections.title_zh: 组织角色不同于客户预览访问
sections.en: User works with channels/posts, Admin additionally manages members/settings, and Super Admin includes billing. Members can manage only lower roles; removal immediately revokes access while created channels/posts remain organization-owned. Cloud team membership needs Team or above, while self-hosted installs include it. Client connection/preview links offer narrower workflows without making the client a colleague. Editorial agency setup: verify the active organization and actual access before inviting people; a calendar customer filter or preview link should not be assumed equivalent to a restricted staff role.
sections.zh: User 操作渠道／帖子，Admin 另管成员／设置，Super Admin 含账单。成员仅管理低于自身角色，移除立即撤权，其创建渠道／帖子仍归组织。Cloud 团队成员需 Team 以上，自托管包含。客户连接／预览链接提供较窄流程，不让客户变同事。编辑机构设置：邀请前确认活动组织及真实访问，不能把日历客户筛选或预览链接当受限员工角色。

sections.title_en: Existing-item backfill and immediate mode can publish at setup
sections.title_zh: 已有条目回填及立即模式可能在设置时发布
sections.en: RSS auto-posting is documented for Cloud Team+ and self-hosted installs. The newest-existing-item switch decides whether to post the current last entry immediately or await a new one. Next available slot uses channel slots; immediate mode publishes when an item is found. AI rewriting/images are optional and consume relevant allowances, while a supplied template gives predictable wording. An Active switch pauses the feed without deleting it. Editorial changelog feed: begin with one intended channel, deliberately choose backfill and timing, then inspect first results before adding destinations. A burst can consume available slots; it is not a guaranteed instant archive importer.
sections.zh: RSS 自动发帖记录为 Cloud Team+ 及自托管可用。是否同步当前最后条目决定立即发最新已有项，或等待新项。Next available slot 用渠道时段，立即模式发现即发。AI 改写／图片可选且占相应额度，自供模板使措辞可预测。Active 开关暂停 feed 不删除。编辑更新日志 feed：先用一个准确渠道，明确回填及时间，再检查首批结果后加目的地。突发条目可耗尽时段，并非保证瞬时档案导入器。

sections.title_en: A like threshold has a finite observation window
sections.title_zh: 点赞阈值有有限观察窗口
sections.en: Auto repost applies to posts up to a week old; auto plug adds a follow-up when a chosen like threshold is reached. X, LinkedIn Page and Bluesky support both; Threads supports follow-up only. They check periodically and give up after a few checks, rather than waiting indefinitely for a late milestone. Saved channel rules apply to future posts. Some composer plugs add separate-account comments/engagement with delays of five minutes to 24 hours. Editorial setup: verify available metrics and the intended follow-up; the resulting action is a real platform post subject to native rules, not a guaranteed engagement lift.
sections.zh: 自动 repost 适用最多一周旧帖，auto plug 在达到所选点赞阈值时加后续帖。X、LinkedIn Page、Bluesky 支持两者，Threads 仅后续。它们定期检查若干次后放弃，不无限等较晚里程碑。已存渠道规则适用于未来帖，部分 composer plugs 可延迟五分钟至 24 小时用其他账户评论／互动。编辑设置：核可得指标及准确后续内容，结果是真实平台帖子、受原生规则约束，并非保证互动提升。

sections.title_en: A webhook reports publication rather than commanding it
sections.title_zh: Webhook 报告发布，不指挥发布
sections.en: Webhooks notify an HTTP receiver when Postiz publishes. Scope all integrations or selected channels, inspect a Send Test payload and return 2xx promptly while handling work asynchronously. The guide asks the receiver to deduplicate repeated delivery; it does not establish a signed-payload, retry-backoff or exactly-once contract. Scope mistakes, unreachable endpoints, response errors and reduced plan allowance can explain silence. Editorial reporting pipeline: map a selected client’s channels to its receiver and verify one controlled event before relying on downstream records. Use API/CLI/MCP for inbound publishing actions rather than confusing a callback with a create-post trigger.
sections.zh: Postiz 发布后 webhook 通知 HTTP 接收方，可限全部或选定渠道。检查 Send Test 载荷，及时返 2xx、异步处理。指南要求接收方去重，并未确定签名载荷、退避重试或精确一次契约。范围错误、端点不可达、响应错误、计划额度减少均可能导致无通知。编辑报告流程：将准确客户渠道映射到接收方，依赖下游记录前验证一个可控事件。入站发布用 API／CLI／MCP，不能将回调混作创建帖子触发。

sections.title_en: Publishing coverage does not imply analytics coverage
sections.title_zh: 发布覆盖不代表分析覆盖
sections.en: The analytics guide says only ten of 34 platforms report account data. LinkedIn metrics are Pages-only; Dribbble offers per-post data without account-level reporting. Available periods vary, commonly 7/30 or 7/30/90 days, and cards compare equal-length prior periods. A newly connected, new/unverified or expired-token account can produce a blank chart; an expired token may break analytics before posting. Editorial report: identify account versus post metrics, scope and available history before comparing. Try the supported period and check connection status rather than replacing unavailable metrics with zero or treating every network as identical.
sections.zh: 分析指南说 34 平台中仅十个回报账户数据，LinkedIn 仅 Pages，Dribbble 有逐帖但无账户报告。可用期不同，常为 7／30 或 7／30／90 天，卡片比较同长度前期。新连接、新／未认证、token 到期账户可能空图，token 到期可能先断分析再断发布。编辑报告：比较前确认账户／逐帖指标、范围及可得历史，尝试支持周期并查连接，不能把不可得填零或将全部网络视同。

sections.title_en: Rejected posts need repair and deliberate rescheduling
sections.title_zh: 被拒帖子需修正并明确重排
sections.en: A failed calendar card has a red ring and platform error tooltip. Troubleshooting separates expired connections, invalid format/settings and provider rejection such as duplicate text, blocked links or account restrictions. Scheduling documentation says Postiz does not silently retry rejected posts: correct the cause and reschedule. Editorial incident check: inspect the native result when unclear, retain the exact account/error and confirm the repaired date before another attempt. Successful publication and post-publication metrics remain separate. No universal delivery SLA or guarantee that reconnecting backfills all missed work was verified.
sections.zh: 失败日历卡有红圈及平台错误提示。故障文档区分连接到期、格式／设置无效，以及重复文字、屏蔽链接、账户限制等提供方拒绝。排程文档说 Postiz 不默默重试被拒帖，需修因重排。编辑故障检查：不明时查原生结果，保留准确账户／错误，再试前确认修正日期。成功发布与之后指标独立，未核普遍投递 SLA 或重连补发全部错过工作的保证。

sections.title_en: AI, clipping and API throughput have different meters
sections.title_zh: AI、剪辑及 API 吞吐使用不同计量
sections.en: Cloud image/video credits are separate: one successful generation spends one, failure spends none, and pools reset on the subscription’s monthly anniversary. Clipping charges source-video minutes, not the output clip count; no-output failure restores minutes. The documented common caps are one clipping at a time, 20/day and 180 minutes per source. Create-post API throughput is 90 requests/hour independent of plan, not 90 posts: requests can batch work. Editorial campaign budget: count channels, generations and source minutes independently, then inspect actual usage/errors. Agent Media is a separately billed UGC product rather than included Postiz video capacity.
sections.zh: Cloud 图片／视频点独立，每次成功生成一点，失败不扣，在订阅月度周年日重置。剪辑按源视频分钟计，不按产出片段数，无输出失败退分钟。共同上限为同时一个、每天 20 次、单源 180 分钟。创建帖 API 每小时 90 请求、各档相同，不是 90 帖，可批处理。编辑活动预算：分别数渠道、生成及源分钟，再查实际用量／错误。Agent Media 是独立收费 UGC 产品，不属 Postiz 包含视频容量。

sections.title_en: A seven-day trial has paid-method and generator restrictions
sections.title_zh: 七天试用有付款方式及生成器限制
sections.en: A trial is normally offered once per organization. It requires a card authorization released immediately; failure prevents starting. Some costly video generators, clipping and reconnecting previously connected channels are restricted. Finish trial bills immediately; otherwise day seven charges the selected plan unless canceled beforehand. Editorial trial: inspect the exact organization/plan and restricted feature before treating a zero-today button as no-card access or full generation capacity. The public pricing FAQ’s general trial language should be read with this specific operational guide.
sections.zh: 试用通常每组织一次，需立即释放的银行卡预授权，失败则不开始。部分高成本视频生成器、剪辑及重连已连接渠道受限。Finish trial 立即收费，否则第七天按所选档扣费，除非提前取消。编辑试用：检查准确组织／档位及受限功能，不能把今天零应付当免卡或完整生成容量。公开定价 FAQ 的一般试用措辞需结合此操作专页。

sections.title_en: A downgrade can disable channels before you choose
sections.title_zh: 降档可能在你选择前禁用渠道
sections.en: The downgrade guide says smaller caps apply immediately and Postiz chooses excess channels to disable. History stays but scheduled work on disabled channels does not publish. Losing team/RSS/webhook allowances disables corresponding access or activity without deleting stored data. After cancellation reaches the paid-period end, publishing and API access stop; queued posts remain and are not published retroactively after resubscribing. Editorial offboarding: choose essential channels and inspect dependent jobs before shrinking capacity, then check actual renewal/end dates. The pricing FAQ’s refund policy allows up to one month under stated conditions and excludes annual plans; cancellation itself is not an automatic refund.
sections.zh: 降档指南说较小上限立即生效，Postiz 自选超额渠道禁用。历史保留，但被禁渠道计划不发。失去团队／RSS／webhook 权益会禁用对应访问或活动，不删除存储。取消到已付期结束后发布及 API 停止，队列保留，重订也不追溯补发。编辑退出：缩容量前选关键渠道、查依赖任务，再核真实续费／结束日期。定价 FAQ 退款政策在所列条件下最多退一个月，排除年付，取消本身不自动退款。

sections.title_en: Self-hosting removes the Cloud subscription gate, not operating costs
sections.title_zh: 自托管免 Cloud 订阅门槛，不免运营成本
sections.en: The install guide recommends Compose with app, Postgres, Redis and Temporal. Operators register provider developer apps/keys for most networks, supply AI/generator keys and run production HTTPS; Cloud manages those preparations. The first signup becomes organization owner. Self-hosting is not proof every provider grants your app publishing access. The repository licence is GNU AGPL version 3 or later, with section 13 requiring a source offer to remote users of a modified network version. It is not a permissive MIT grant. Editorial deployment evaluation: budget infrastructure, approvals, credentials, upgrades and the actual licence obligations before choosing it over managed Cloud. No server was started here.
sections.zh: 安装指南推荐 Compose，含应用、Postgres、Redis、Temporal。自托管者为多数网络注册开发者应用／key，提供 AI／生成器 key，并运行生产 HTTPS，Cloud 代管准备。首个注册者成为组织所有者，自托管不能证明提供方授予你的应用发布访问。仓库为 GNU AGPL 第三版或后续版，第 13 节要求修改后网络版本向远程用户提供源码获取机会，不是宽松 MIT。编辑部署评估：选择前预算基础设施、批准、凭据、升级及实际许可义务，此处未启动服务器。
